inputs.name: hand over from Data Labeling Pipeline to Data Versioning

output.level_0: Data Versioning rejects data from Data Labeling Pipeline without error messages.
output.level_1: There is no connection between Data Labeling Pipeline and Data Versioning.
output.level_2: Team members manually transfer data from Data Labeling Pipeline to Data Versioning.
output.level_3: Data Labeling Pipeline automatically exports labeled data to Data Versioning.
output.level_4: Data Versioning validates and logs all incoming data from Data Labeling Pipeline.
